title: Lower-limb MI dataset for knee pain patients from Zuo et al. 2025
description: A lower-limb motor imagery EEG dataset comprising 30 knee pain patients performing left and right leg flexion/extension imagery tasks across 5 sessions. The dataset contains 500 trials (250 per class) recorded at 500 Hz from 30 EEG channels using a standard 10-05 montage. This clinical dataset supports the development and evaluation of brain-computer interface classifiers for motor rehabilitation applications in patients with knee pain.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 30 knee pain patients (12 female, 18 male; mean age 33.5 years) using a ZhenTec EEG system with 30 channels at 500 Hz sampling rate. Participants performed cue-based motor imagery of left and right leg movements in a 2-class paradigm across 5 sessions, with 100 trials per session (50 per class). Visual cues indicated the imagery task, with 4-second trial duration and no feedback provided. Reference electrode was CPz and ground was FPz, with 50 Hz line frequency.
